title: Introduction To Computer Networks
summary: Network architectures, OSI vs TCP/IP models, topologies, transmission media, and hardware devices.
description: Comprehensive introduction to computer networking principles, architectural models (OSI and TCP/IP), network topologies, guided and unguided transmission media, client-server vs P2P architectures, and essential network hardware devices.
selfLearning: Study of Campus-Wide Networking (3-tier hierarchical design, core/distribution/access layers, VLANs, and firewall DMZs).
